judgments.reason: Specification claims bids above available coins can win due to commission being included before payment, but the rules state "a bid cannot exceed your coins" and that the winner "pays the bid, gains the lot, then receives a three-coin auction commission." The model did not articulate the claimed mechanism.

Specification asserts waiting reveals sealed rival bids; the rules explicitly treat commitments as sealed and say "Only resolved bids are normally public." The model did not state any mechanism where waiting reveals committed sealed bids.

Specification claims close can settle with unauctioned lots, but the rule for close is "settles after all three lots are sold." The transcript also shows close after all lots were resolved. The model did not support the claimed alternate terminal condition.

Specification alleges catalog purchases receive the three-coin auction commission; the rules describe the three-coin commission as granted to the auction winner ("winner pays the bid, gains the lot, then receives a three-coin auction commission") and state "catalog items are not auction wins." The model did not articulate the claimed substitution.
